brief.prompt: A woman with shoulder-length hair tucked behind her ears stands facing a bright window, her face evenly lit by soft daylight, looking straight ahead with a relaxed expression. Plain light-colored wall behind her, photographed straight on at eye level from a comfortable distance.
brief.alt: Woman facing soft window light at eye level, the kind of even, straight-on photo that gives a face rating app a consistent input
brief.purpose: Shows what a controlled, evenly lit, straight-on photo looks like, in contrast to the uncontrolled selfies that consumer apps usually receive.

review.alt: Woman with shoulder-length brown hair and small gold hoop earrings, wearing a cream knit sweater, facing the camera with a relaxed expression beside a bright window against a plain light wall, evenly lit and photographed straight on at eye level.
